CHARTERING MARKET AT HAND: HANDYSIZE AND SUPRAMAX/ULTRAMAX// WEEK 35
**Handysize/Supramax sentiment keeps improving in USG, Continent and Asia- Pacific, while pressure is mounting in the Mediterranean and ECSA markets**
In the USG, demand for Supramax/Ultramax tonnage is gradually picking up this week. While owners are attempting to push rates higher when negotiating fronthaul routes, this is off the table for transatlantic and short inter-Caribs trips. Competition for these cargoes remains quite fierce among owners, as most prefer to keep their carriers within the Atlantic while waiting for the US grain export season to kick off.
